quote.content: ❝The purpose of art is washing the dust of daily life off our souls.❞
quote.author: Pablo Picasso

home_presentation.description:
In a troubled age — has it ever been otherwise? —, there is a quiet joy to let the impulses of one's heart flow freely, to ease the mind, and to immerse oneself in the fresh currents of the search for beauty. It feels good to shut the door on the surrounding noise and simply listen to the depth of the world. 

Here, you will find a few humble attempts in that spirit.

about.title: About
about.description:
Hi ! My name is Fabien, and I’m an engineering student at Centrale Lyon and Politecnico di Milano ! I’m passionate about computer science and science in general as well as art and literature ! 

I built this entire website using Vite and React for the frontend, and Django, Python, and PostgreSQL for the backend. Find the github project [here](https://github.com/Fabien-ross/personal-website)! 

If you encounter a bug or for any other reason, feel free to send me a message !

novels_presentation.title: Novels
novels_presentation.description:
Stories are surely one of the best ways to express the inexpressible by building new worlds, at the edge of reality. 

Dive into one of them !

poems_presentation.title: Poems
poems_presentation.description:
When I was a kid, I could not understand the point of poetry: a few rhymes and strange stories, somewhat artificial. 

But soon I grew up and learned that so much can be said with so few words...
